name: OpenPencil
short_desc: Self-hosted, browser-based design editor with cloud project storage.
author: OpenPencil contributors
description: OpenPencil Cloud runs the OpenPencil design editor in your browser and stores projects on your own server, in PostgreSQL and SeaweedFS object storage, with accounts, sharing and live collaboration. Sign-up emails are delivered to a built-in inbox at /mailpit/.

form_fields.label: Mail inbox password
form_fields.pattern_error: Use at least 12 characters with no spaces or colons.
form_fields.hint: Protects the built-in inbox at /mailpit/ (username: mail), where sign-up and password-reset emails arrive.

form_fields.label: Account sign-up

options.label: Open: anyone who can reach the server can create an account

form_fields.hint: Create your accounts first, then switch to Closed in the app settings.
